# Years 1998-2002, 2005, 2008, 2010, 2012-2014 come from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Dally_M_Awards_winners (the page prints no year labels; order was aligned against the per-year pages for 2004, 2006, 2007, 2009, 2011, 2015 which all matched with 2003 skipped).
# 2003: not awarded (industrial action) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dally_M_Medal
